text:
anna (iso auditor): Hi team — we need a concise evidence package for a suspected RBAC edit that occurred during a vuln triage. Goal: prove the RBAC change did not cause any KMS decrypts outside normal patterns. Time window: 2026-04-02T09:10:00Z -> 2026-04-02T09:50:00Z.

rahul: Copy. Can you confirm the principal that was edited?

anna (iso auditor): ServiceAccount: infra/backup-reader (rolebinding updated at ~09:22).

mike: Ok. Plan: pull k8s audit events for RoleBinding updates, IAM history for any linked AWS role assume events, CloudTrail Decrypt events for keys with alias starting alias/redwood-prod- and S3 GetObject ops. We'll produce a minimal bundle with a mapping file.

rahul: Commands I used:

kubectl --context=prod get events --all-namespaces --field-selector reason=RoleBindingUpdated -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.creationTimestamp>="2026-04-02T09:10:00Z" and .metadata.creationTimestamp<="2026-04-02T09:50:00Z")' > k8s_rbac_changes.json

aws iam list-role-policies --role-name redwood-backup-role > role_policies.json

aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-04-02T09:10:00Z --end-time 2026-04-02T09:50:00Z --query 'Events[]' > cloudtrail_decrypts.json

mike: For CloudWatch Logs Insights (if needed):

fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters
| filter eventName = "Decrypt" and @timestamp >= '2026-04-02T09:10:00Z' and @timestamp <= '2026-04-02T09:50:00Z'
| sort @timestamp asc

rahul: S3 access log sample (we keep ALB+S3 logs in redwood-access-logs):

aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/04/02/09/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-04-02T09:10:00Z' AND '2026-04-02T09:50:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads_window.json

mike: Cross-check heuristic: link decrypt event's principal (userIdentity.arn) against the role binding delta by mapping serviceAccount -> IAM role (via IRSA annotation) and by matching request IDs if present. If timing shows decrypts before the RBAC change, it's not caused by the edit.

anna (iso auditor): For audit reasons, include the exact CLI commands and the git sha of the export script. Also include a short narrative per decrypt: why it's considered related/unrelated.

rahul: We'll produce a zipped package with:
- export_manifest.txt (window, exported-by, git-sha, checksums)
- k8s_rbac_changes.json (kube-apiserver audit slice)
- iam_role_history.json (role assume / policy snapshot)
- cloudtrail_decrypts.json (Decrypt events)
- s3_reads_window.json (S3 GETs in window)
- exhibit_map.txt (mapping lines: RBAC event -> KMS event(s) -> S3 read(s) with reasoning)
- redaction_log.txt (what was redacted and why)
- extract_cmds.sh (the exact commands used)

mike: We'll run a PII scan and replace full object keys with hashed placeholders in the bundle; redaction_log will show mapping for auditor review.

ops-bot: Preparing export: evidence_pkg_6241234567_20260402. Staging to s3://redwood-compliance-staging/. Presigned URL will be generated for download.

devops-bot: Check: KMS keys considered: alias/redwood-prod-cache, alias/redwood-prod-storage. Using key ARNs to filter Decrypt events is recommended.

rahul: Note: we saw 3 Decrypt calls at 09:18, 09:21, 09:24 from role arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-backup-role/session. The RoleBinding edit at 09:22 alters infra/backup-reader -> that maps to redwood-backup-role via IRSA. Two Decrypts predate the change, one is at 09:24 (post-change) — will investigate that session id.

mike: We'll include session token issuance logs and kube token issuer logs to validate whether the post-change decrypt used newly-granted permissions. If it's a long-lived session from before the edit, it's unrelated.

ops-bot: Export complete. Object: s3://redwood-compliance-staging/evidence_pkg_6241234567_20260402.zip. Presigned link: https://presigned.example/evidence/6241234567 (valid 5 days). SHA256: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e

anna (iso auditor): Downloading now. Please make sure the exhibit_map.txt has the short narrative per event. If the post-change decrypt remains ambiguous mark "action: further forensic analysis" and escalate to oncall.

rahul: Will attach a note in exhibit_map.txt for the 09:24 decrypt with request id and session ARN. ETA ~20m for the annotated map.

mike: Closing loop after anna confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
